subject: Z target lock
text: Setting Z target lock in the main menu to Hold makes the Barinade battle much easier.

evidence.quote: Strong suggestion to turn your Z target lock in the main menu to "Hold", this will make this fight much easier.

subject: Barinade
text: At the start of the Barinade fight, roll forward twice, step forward, target the three top tentacles with the boomerang, and hit the center to stun the boss and defeat jellyfish with Deku nuts.

evidence.quote: As soon as the Boss starts, roll forward twice and take a couple steps forward. Target the three tentacles up top with your boomerang hit one, side hop twice, hit the next one, then side hop back to your original position and hit the third. Let go of the Z target and immediately throw your boomerang to hit the boss in the center. If timed right the boss will be stunned, throw deku nuts to kill all the jellyfish.

subject: Barinade
text: After hitting Barinade with the boomerang in the final phase, jump slash it with Deku sticks.

evidence.quote: Walk diagonally to keep close enough to the boss to hit it with boomerang. After hitting the boss, jump slash with deku sticks.

subject: Spiritual Stone of Water
text: The Spiritual Stone of Water is obtained after defeating Barinade.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] - After defeating Barinade.

subject: Fishing Pond
text: Catching a big fish standing out from the log on the left of the fishing pond requires pulling the reel against the fish by holding left or right all the way.

evidence.quote: On the left after entering the fishing pond, there is a log sticking out in the water. Stand on that log, find big fish that stands out. To lure the fish, try to ease into going back on the analog stick and hitting B. Once you get a bite, just make sure the real is being pulled against the fish, so usually that means hold left or hold right all the way.

subject: Deku Nuts upgrade
text: Wearing the Mask of Truth down the hidden Grotto in the Lost Woods grants the final Deku Nut upgrade, which becomes permanently missable after getting the poacher's saw as an adult.

evidence.quote: [Missable] Grab the Mask of Truth through the Happy Mask quest line and go down the hidden Grotto in the Lost Woods. The same as you did with the skull mask, once down the hole using the Mask of Truth will grant you your Final Deku Nut upgrade....Due to a game bug once you grab the poacher's saw as an adult through the trading side quest it becomes missable.

subject: Castle Town gate cutscene
text: A cutscene triggers at the Castle Town gate after obtaining the three spiritual stones.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] After obtaining the three spiritual stones stones, a cutscene will trigger at the Castle Town gate.

subject: Dying guard
text: Talking to the dying guard in the back alley after getting the ocarina from Zelda is missable because the guard disappears after triggering the Temple of Time cutscenes.

evidence.quote: [Missable] After obtaining the ocarina from Zelda, go to Hyrule Castle in back alley there is a guard you can talk too. Hear his dying words to obtain this hidden Dialogue....After you trigger the temple of time cut scenes the guard never appears again.

subject: Stone of Agony
text: Collecting 20 Gold Skulltulas rewards an item that displays a symbol on the bottom left showing hidden grottos.

evidence.quote: _Collect 20 Gold Skulltulas and obtain your reward_ ... [Info in 30 Gold Skulltulas] Although this item may seem useless, it will show you where hidden grotto's are on the bottom left you will see the symbol.

subject: Gold Skulltulas
text: Collecting 30 Gold Skulltulas is recommended before entering the Temple of Time because Link cannot turn back into Young Link until after the Forest Temple.

evidence.quote: I highly recommend getting 30 Gold Skulltulas before you go to the Temple of Time, because you won't be able to turn back into young link till after the Forest Temple.

subject: Adult Link
text: Playing the Song of Time at the Temple of Time transforms Link into Adult Link.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] Go to Temple of Time and play Song of Time.

subject: Hookshot
text: Pushing the grave near the soft soil bean location in Kakariko Village graveyard leads to Dampé's Crypt, where following Dampé to the end awards the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: After going forward in time seven years, head to Kakariko Village's graveyard. Near the soft soil bean location there is a grave you push to head to Dampé's Crypt. Follow Dampe all the way to the end to revive your hookshot!

subject: Epona
text: Calling Epona with Epona's Song at Lon Lon Ranch, winning the race two times in a row, and jumping out of the ranch frees Epona.

evidence.quote: Head to Lon Lon Ranch, Use Epona's Song to call for Epona. Win the Race two times in a row and jump out of Lon Lon Ranch with Epona to Free Epona.

subject: Goron Tunic
text: Blowing up the rolling Goron inside Goron City awards the Goron Tunic for free.

evidence.quote: Inside Goron City, blow up the rolling goron to obtain your Goron Tunic free.

subject: Iron Boots
text: The Ice Cavern is reached from where Jabu Jabu was, and two extra blue flames should be gathered before obtaining the Iron Boots.

evidence.quote: Head to where Jabu Jabu once was, from there you can head to the Ice Carven. Make sure to grab two extra blue flame for inside the zora's domain before grabbing the Iron Boots.

subject: Zora Tunic
text: Using blue flame on the shop door in Zora's Domain allows Link to purchase the Zora Tunic for 300 rupees.

evidence.quote: Head back to Zoro's Domain with blue flame from the Ice Carven, use it on the shop door to buy the Zora Tunic for 300 rupees.

subject: King Zora
text: Talking to King Zora while equipped with the Zora Tunic before thawing him from red ice causes him to blow Link a kiss instead of giving a tunic.

evidence.quote: [Missable] Make sure to buy a Zora tunic and equip the Zora tunic before unfreezing the King from red ice. If you talk to the king while wearing the Zora tunic he will blow you a kiss....If you don't wear the Zora tunic, he will give you a Zora tunic instead not a kiss.

subject: Biggoron's Sword
text: Beginning the Biggoron's Sword side quest requires freeing King Zora from red ice and acquiring Epona to jump over the bridge.

evidence.quote:
Requirements

- Free King Zora from the Red Ice. 
- Acquire Epona. [Need to jump over bridge]

subject: Pocket Egg
text: The Cucco Lady in Kakariko Village provides a Pocket Egg that hatches after one night into a Cucco used to wake Talon and receive a blue Cucco.

evidence.quote: 1. Talk to the Cucco Lady in Kakariko Village, she will give you a Pocket Egg. After one night passes, the egg will hatch. Inside the Kakariko Village is Malon's Father, use the Cucco to walk up Talon. Go back to Cucco Lady to receive a special blue Cucco

subject: Odd Mushroom
text: The Craftsman's son in the Lost Woods gives an Odd Mushroom that must be delivered to the Potion Shop in Kakariko Village within 3 minutes.

evidence.quote: 2. Head to Lost woods, go where you gave the skull mask to lost kid to find the Craftsman's son. He will give you an Odd mushroom, you then have three minutes to travel it the Potion Shop in Kakariko Village.

subject: Poacher's Saw
text: Trading the Old Poultice to Fado in the Lost Woods awards the Poacher's Saw.

evidence.quote: 4. Head back to the Lost Woods where the Carftsman's son was to find Fado, trade the Old Poultice to receive the Poacher's Saw.

subject: Broken Goron's Sword
text: Trading the Poacher's Saw to the Master Craftsman across the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley gives the Broken Goron's Sword.

evidence.quote: 5. Use Epona to travel to Gerudo Valley you will need to jump over the broken bridge. You can Talk to the Master Craftsman to trade your Poacher's Saw for Broken Goron's Sword

subject: Eyeball Frog
text: Delivering King Zora's prescription yields the Eyeball Frog, which must be brought to the scientist in Lakeside Laboratory within 3 minutes.

evidence.quote: 7. Once you talked to King Zora and presented the prescription to make the Wolrd's Finest Eye Drops, the king will give you Eyeball Frog. You will have three minutes to deliver the Eyeball frog to the scientist in Lakeside Laboratory in Lake Hylia.

subject: Eye Drops
text: The Lake Hylia scientist gives Eye Drops that must be carried to the Big Goron on Death Mountain within 4 minutes.

evidence.quote: The laboratory is the first building you see, the scientist will then hand you the Eye Drops. Once you received the eye drops you have four minutes to climb back up to reach the big goron on Death Mountain.

subject: Biggoron's Sword
text: Playing the Sun's Song 6 times inside Death Mountain fast-forwards 3 days to claim the Biggoron's Sword from the claim check.

evidence.quote: Once up top you will receive the claim check that makes you wait three games to get the Biggoron sword. If you go inside Death Mountain, play the song of sun six different times. It will fast forward three days, making easy claim for sword.

subject: Phantom Ganon
text: During Phantom Ganon's first phase, standing in the middle of corner floor lines protects Link from attack while determining the real painting by the louder footsteps and darker color.

evidence.quote: 1. Look on the floor you will see lines leading the corners, stand in the middle of the those corners by doing so you won't get hit by his attack if you miss the shot. Turn up the volume, you want will see two ganon's inside the painting coming towards you. Once you hear the footsteps coming closer to you, you know that is the real painting what ever is the loudest. You can also tell which is the fake Ganon by the color, the darker Ganon with the whiter whites is the real one. Wait until the portal appears then shoot your arrow, rinse and repeat three times.

subject: Phantom Ganon
text: In Phantom Ganon's second phase, deflect energy balls using an equipped empty bottle until the boss reaches 1 HP.

evidence.quote: 2. Make sure you have an empty bottle equipped and it's easier to hit the ball than you realize. May take a little practice to understand the timing, the bottle has a shorter swing and reach than the master sword, but lingers longer than you would expect. Keep on hitting the boss with the empty bottle until  the boss reaches 1 hp to get your achievement.

subject: Forest Medallion
text: Saria awakens and awards the Forest Medallion after defeating Phantom Ganon.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] After defeating Phantom Ganon.

subject: Shooting Gallery
text: The adult Shooting Gallery is located in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote: The Gallery is in Kakriko Village now, same set up as child link, refer to Sniper Fury for more details.

subject: Volvagia
text: Volvagia emerges from one of 9 holes in the ground and can be stunned with a hammer jump slash, then damaged with the Biggoron's Sword.

evidence.quote: 1. At the start of the fight the boss will come out of a random hole out of the nine placed on the ground, wait for it to spin then run up and Jump slash with hammer to stun it, then biggoron sword to do damage.

subject: Volvagia
text: Hanging off the ledge of the arena when Volvagia burrows underground causes the boss to immediately return underground.

evidence.quote: 2. Jump off the side of the arena as soon as she goes back underground. Link will grab onto the ledge instead of jumping, and when Volvagia can't find you, she'll immediately go back underground.

subject: Fire Medallion
text: Darunia awakens and grants the Fire Medallion after defeating Volvagia.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] After defeating Volvagia.

subject: Bonooru the Scarecrow
text: Playing a custom song to Bonooru the Scarecrow as Young Link and repeating it as Adult Link unlocks the Scarecrow's Song to summon Pierre to secret hookshot spots.

evidence.quote: As young Link head to Lake Hylia, talk to Bonooru the Scarecrow and make up a song you will remember on your own. Come back as adult Link to that same scarecrow and play the same song to unlock the "scarecrow" song. Now you play that song and the scarecrow will show in certain places allowing you to hookshot into secret areas.

subject: Morpha
text: Standing in the corner of the map keeps Link out of Morpha's reach while hookshotting its nucleus through tentacles and slashing it with Biggoron's Sword.

evidence.quote: [Missable] As soon as the boss starts, make your way to the corner of the map. If you stay in that corner Morpha will never be able to reach you, use Biggoron's sword to your advantage. Hook shot Morpha as it goes through the tentacles, either spin attack or if you are brave enough as soon you hookshot Morpha go around and keep slashing Morpha in the corner for an easy defeat.

subject: Fire Arrow
text: Shooting an arrow into the rising sun while standing on the stone at Lake Hylia unlocks the Fire Arrow, with Sun's Song allowing retries.

evidence.quote: After obtaining the Water Medallion you will be teleported to Lake Hyila, stand on the stone and shoot an arrow at the sun as it's rising. Doing so will unlock the Fire arrow for you to obtain. If you miss it, just play Sun Song twice to retry.

subject: Lens of Truth
text: The Lens of Truth is located under the well in Kakariko Village after learning the Song of Storms.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] In Kakariko Village after learning the Song of Storms, Under the Well.

subject: Bongo Bongo
text: Equip Hover Boots at the start of Bongo Bongo to target a hand, unequip them to dodge fist attacks, shoot the eye between the hands when it charges, and finish it with Biggoron's Sword jump slashes and crouch stabs.

evidence.quote: The Target to stun Bongo Bongo is in between the hands after shooting both....1. Wear the Hover Boots as soon as the boss starts Z target on the hand from left or right side. Once one hand is down, unequip hover boots to be able to dodge the second hand if it turns into a fist....2. The boss will slam itself on the ground charge forward, I normally shoot just as the hands are about to reach me/when they are right next to me....3. Jump slash with biggoron sword then crouch stab it to death to one-cycle the boss.

subject: Morpha
text: Story progression continues after defeating Morpha.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] After Defeating Morpha.

subject: Bongo Bongo
text: Story progression continues after defeating Bongo Bongo.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] After defeating Bongo Bongo.
